verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail is a virtual-mailbox SaaS, and outbound event webhooks (for example, on new mail received) are a fair capability for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence only makes generic claims about 'APIs to connect your virtual mailbox to the tools you already use'. That describes an adjacent API capability, not documented, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks, so there is no evidence of webhook subscriptions.
